def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    cells = defaultdict(set)
    for r in range(h):

                cells[grid[r][c]].add((r, c))

    rays = set()
    for color, pts in cells.items():
        other = [(r, c) for col, ps in cells.items() if col != color for r, c in ps]
        if not other:
            continue
        mr = sum(r for r, c in other) / len(other)
        mc = sum(c for r, c in other) / len(other)
        for r, c in pts:
            for dr in (-1, 1):
                for dc in (-1, 1):
                    q = (r + dr, c + dc)
                    if q not in pts or (r, c) > q:
                        continue
                    # Continue from the pair endpoint whose continuation moves
                    # farther away from the differently-colored seed motif.
                    ends = ((r, c, -dr, -dc), (q[0], q[1], dr, dc))
                    er, ec, sr, sc = max(

    for color, r, c, dr, dc in rays:
